title: GPT-4o joins the text model list
summary:
GPT-4o joined the text model list, while web-search defaults and vision examples got clearer.

Added `openai-large`, backed by GPT-4o, alongside the existing GPT-4o-mini-backed `openai` model. Both are listed as supporting vision.

Text requests using web search now get a search-specific default prompt when callers do not provide one. The general default prompt also stops asking for optional Pollinations links.

Added image-analysis examples for GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, covering image URLs, base64-encoded images, and a Python request.

highlights.title: GPT-4o as openai-large
highlights.text: Use `openai-large` for GPT-4o chat and image analysis. The existing `openai` model remains backed by GPT-4o-mini. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
